_README: SANITIZED ILLUSTRATION — NOT A DROP-IN IMPORT.
This is a genericized version of a production n8n workflow, published as a portfolio code sample.
All credentials, internal hostnames, schema names, table/column names, and client identifiers
have been removed or replaced with neutral placeholders. The control flow and SQL/JS logic are
faithful to the original pattern; the names are not. Do not expect it to run as-is.
Pattern: scheduled job that, per demander, pulls already-LLM-generated variant rows,
skips anything previously published, flattens the generated attributes into the demander's
expected column names, writes a CSV, drops it to storage, and logs what was exported so the
next run is incremental and safe to re-run. The production workflow fans this same branch out
across many demanders; only one generic branch is shown here.
name: demand-generation-demander-csv (sanitized)

parameters.query:
-- Pull LLM-generated variant rows for ONE demander that have not been published yet.
WITH pending_products AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT vo.product_id
    FROM generation.generated_variants vo
    LEFT JOIN published_product_pages pub
        ON pub.demander_id = vo.demander_id AND pub.product_id = vo.product_id
    WHERE vo.demander_id = $1
      AND pub.product_id IS NULL   -- skip anything already pushed
    ORDER BY vo.product_id ASC
    LIMIT 20000
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (vo.variant_id) vo.generated_fields
FROM generation.generated_variants vo
INNER JOIN demander_product_queue q ON q.product_id = vo.product_id
WHERE vo.demander_id = $1
  AND vo.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM pending_products)
ORDER BY vo.variant_id ASC, vo.created_at ASC;

parameters.query:
-- Record what we just exported so the next run skips it (idempotent / re-runnable).
INSERT INTO published_product_pages (demander_id, product_id, variant_id, published_at)
SELECT $1, product_id, variant_id, NOW()
FROM generation.generated_variants
WHERE demander_id = $1
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
